Q01: SELECT COUNT(*) AS hub_count FROM airports WHERE is_cargo_hub = 1
Q02: SELECT tail_number, year_manufactured FROM aircraft WHERE status = 'active' AND year_manufactured >= 2015 ORDER BY year_manufactured DESC, tail_number ASC
Q03: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_flights FROM flights WHERE status = 'cancelled'
Q04: SELECT model, max_payload_kg FROM aircraft_types ORDER BY max_payload_kg DESC
Q05: SELECT SUM(declared_value_usd) AS total_declared_value_usd FROM shipments WHERE commodity_category = 'pharmaceuticals' AND status = 'delivered'
Q06: SELECT name, country FROM customers WHERE payment_terms_days = 45 ORDER BY name, country
Q07: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipments GROUP BY status ORDER BY status ASC
Q08: SELECT tail_number FROM aircraft WHERE aircraft_id NOT IN (SELECT aircraft_id FROM flights) ORDER BY tail_number
Q09: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_fra_departures FROM flights WHERE origin_airport_id = (SELECT airport_id FROM airports WHERE iata_code = 'FRA') AND status = 'completed'
Q10: SELECT a.name AS airline_name, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS completed_flights FROM airlines a LEFT JOIN flights f ON a.airline_id = f.airline_id AND f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY completed_flights DESC, a.name
Q11: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, ROUND(SUM(s.declared_value_usd), 2) AS total_declared_value_usd FROM customers c JOIN shipments s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id WHERE s.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_declared_value_usd DESC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 5
Q12: SELECT T2.iata_code, COUNT(T1.completed_arrival) AS completed_arrivals FROM flights AS T1 JOIN airports AS T2 ON T1.destination_airport_id = T2.airport_id WHERE T1.status = 'completed' GROUP BY T2.iata_code HAVING COUNT(T1.completed_arrival) > 150 ORDER BY completed_arrivals DESC, T2.iata_code ASC
Q13: SELECT a.iata_code, ROUND(AVG(julianday(f.actual_departure) - julianday(f.scheduled_departure)) * 24 * 60, 1) AS avg_departure_delay_min FROM airports a JOIN flights f ON a.airport_id = f.origin_airport_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.iata_code HAVING COUNT(f.flight_id) >= 40 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay_min DESC, a.iata_code
Q14: SELECT customer_id, name FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM shipments WHERE status != 'cancelled') ORDER BY customer_id
Q15: SELECT i.customer_id, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS total_invoiced_usd, SUM(COALESCE(p.amount_usd, 0)) AS total_paid_usd, ROUND(SUM(i.amount_usd) - SUM(COALESCE(p.amount_usd, 0)), 2) AS outstanding_usd FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN payments p ON i.invoice_id = p.invoice_id WHERE i.status = 'unpaid' GROUP BY i.customer_id ORDER BY outstanding_usd DESC, i.customer_id LIMIT 10
Q16: SELECT service_level, COUNT(*) AS connecting_shipments FROM shipments JOIN flight_cargo ON shipments.shipment_id = flight_cargo.shipment_id WHERE leg_number > 1 GROUP BY service_level ORDER BY service_level
Q17: SELECT T1.model, ROUND(SUM(T2.total_weight_kg) / T1.max_payload_kg * 100, 1) AS avg_load_factor_pct FROM aircraft_types AS T1 INNER JOIN aircraft AS T2 ON T1.type_id = T2.type_id INNER JOIN flights AS T3 ON T2.aircraft_id = T3.aircraft_id INNER JOIN flight_cargo AS T4 ON T3.flight_id = T4.flight_id INNER JOIN shipments AS T5 ON T4.shipment_id = T5.shipment_id WHERE T3.status = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.model ORDER BY avg_load_factor_pct DESC
Q18: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', T1.actual_departure) AS month, SUM(T2.chargeable_weight_kg) AS total_kg_flown FROM flights AS T1 JOIN shipments AS T2 ON T1.shipment_id = T2.shipment_id WHERE T1.status = 'completed' AND T2.chargeable_weight_kg > 0 AND T1.actual_departure LIKE '2025-%' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
Q19: SELECT origin_airport_id AS origin_iata, destination_airport_id AS destination_iata, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY origin_airport_id, destination_airport_id ORDER BY origin_airport_id, destination_airport_id
Q20: SELECT shipment_id, ROUND((strftime('%s', T1.actual_arrival) - strftime('%s', T1.scheduled_arrival)) / 3600, 1) AS hours_late FROM flights AS T1 JOIN flight_cargo AS T2 ON T1.flight_id = T2.flight_id WHERE T2.leg_number = (SELECT MAX(leg_number) FROM flight_cargo WHERE shipment_id = T2.shipment_id) AND T1.status = 'completed' AND T2.leg_status = 'flown' ORDER BY hours_late DESC, shipment_id ASC LIMIT 10
Q21: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers c WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT s.customer_id FROM shipments s WHERE s.status = 'delivered') AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT i.customer_id FROM incidents i JOIN flight_cargo fc ON i.flight_cargo_id = fc.flight_cargo_id JOIN shipments s ON fc.shipment_id = s.shipment_id WHERE s.status = 'delivered') ORDER BY c.customer_id
Q22: SELECT customer_id, MAX(booking_date) AS latest_booking_date, MAX(shipment_id) AS shipment_id FROM shipments GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY customer_id
Q23: SELECT i.invoice_id, c.name AS customer_name, julianday('2025-12-20') - julianday(i.due_date) AS days_overdue, ROUND(i.amount_usd - SUM(p.amount_usd), 2) AS outstanding_usd FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN payments p ON i.invoice_id = p.invoice_id WHERE i.due_date < '2025-12-20' AND (p.amount_usd IS NULL OR p.amount_usd < i.amount_usd) GROUP BY i.invoice_id, c.name ORDER BY days_overdue DESC, i.invoice_id ASC LIMIT 10
Q24: SELECT c.commodity_category, COUNT(fcl.flight_cargo_id) AS flown_legs, SUM(CASE WHEN i.incident_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incidents, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i.incident_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(fcl.flight_cargo_id), 4) AS incident_rate FROM shipments s LEFT JOIN flight_cargo fcl ON s.shipment_id = fcl.shipment_id AND fcl.leg_status = 'flown' LEFT JOIN incidents i ON fcl.flight_cargo_id = i.flight_cargo_id GROUP BY c.commodity_category ORDER BY incident_rate DESC, commodity_category
Q25: SELECT a1.iata_code AS airport_a, a2.iata_code AS airport_b, COUNT(CASE WHEN f1.origin_airport_id = a1.airport_id AND f1.destination_airport_id = a2.airport_id THEN 1 END) AS flights_a_to_b, COUNT(CASE WHEN f2.origin_airport_id = a2.airport_id AND f2.destination_airport_id = a1.airport_id THEN 1 END) AS flights_b_to_a FROM airports a1 JOIN airports a2 ON a1.iata_code < a2.iata_code LEFT JOIN flights f1 ON a1.airport_id = f1.origin_airport_id AND a2.airport_id = f1.destination_airport_id AND f1.status = 'completed' LEFT JOIN flights f2 ON a2.airport_id = f2.origin_airport_id AND a1.airport_id = f2.destination_airport_id AND f2.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a1.iata_code, a2.iata_code HAVING flights_a_to_b > 0 AND flights_b_to_a > 0 ORDER BY a1.iata_code, a2.iata_code
Q26: SELECT COUNT(*) AS bonded_warehouses FROM warehouses WHERE is_bonded = 1
Q27: SELECT employee_number, first_name, last_name FROM crew_members WHERE crew_rank = 'captain' AND license_expiry_date < '2025-12-20' ORDER BY employee_number
Q28: SELECT dg_class, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipments WHERE dg_class IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dg_class ORDER BY dg_class
Q29: SELECT account_code, name FROM customers WHERE loyalty_tier = 'platinum' ORDER BY account_code
Q30: SELECT ROUND(SUM(co2_emissions_kg) / 1000, 1) AS total_co2_tonnes FROM fuel_uplifts WHERE flight_id IN (SELECT flight_id FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed')
Q31: SELECT cancellation_reason, COUNT(*) AS cancelled_flights FROM flights WHERE status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY cancellation_reason ORDER BY cancelled_flights DESC, cancellation_reason ASC
Q32: SELECT T1.iata_code, ROUND(AVG(T2.price_usd_per_litre), 4) AS avg_price_usd_per_litre FROM airports AS T1 INNER JOIN fuel_uplifts AS T2 ON T1.airport_id = T2.airport_id GROUP BY T1.iata_code ORDER BY avg_price_usd_per_litre DESC, T1.iata_code ASC
Q33: SELECT customs_country, ROUND(SUM(duty_amount_usd), 2) AS total_duty_usd, ROUND(SUM(vat_amount_usd), 2) AS total_vat_usd, ROUND(SUM(duty_amount_usd + vat_amount_usd), 2) AS total_taxes_usd FROM customs_declarations WHERE declaration_type = 'import' AND status = 'cleared' GROUP BY customs_country ORDER BY total_taxes_usd DESC, customs_country ASC
Q34: SELECT a.name AS airline_name, c.crew_rank, COUNT(c.crew_member_id) AS active_crew FROM airlines a JOIN crew_members c ON a.airline_id = c.airline_id WHERE c.is_active = 1 GROUP BY a.name, c.crew_rank ORDER BY a.name, c.crew_rank
Q35: SELECT a.tail_number, ROUND(SUM(m.parts_cost_usd + m.labor_cost_usd), 2) AS total_maintenance_cost_usd FROM aircraft a JOIN maintenance_records m ON a.aircraft_id = m.aircraft_id WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.tail_number ORDER BY total_maintenance_cost_usd DESC, a.tail_number ASC LIMIT 5
Q36: SELECT insurer_name, COUNT(*) AS claims, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('approved', 'paid') THEN approved_amount_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_approved_usd FROM insurance_claims GROUP BY insurer_name ORDER BY insurer_name
Q37: SELECT w.warehouse_code, a.iata_code, COUNT(t.event_id) AS rcs_scans FROM warehouses w JOIN airports a ON w.airport_id = a.airport_id JOIN tracking_events t ON w.warehouse_id = t.warehouse_id WHERE t.event_code = 'RCS' GROUP BY w.warehouse_code, a.iata_code HAVING rcs_scans > 150 ORDER BY rcs_scans DESC, w.warehouse_code ASC
Q38: SELECT a.model, ROUND(SUM(f.fuel_burned_kg) * 100 / SUM(f.distance_km), 1) AS fuel_kg_per_100km FROM aircraft a JOIN aircraft_types at ON a.type_id = at.type_id JOIN flights f ON a.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.model ORDER BY fuel_kg_per_100km DESC, a.model ASC
Q39: SELECT a.name AS airline_name, c.employee_number, ROUND(SUM(ca.block_minutes_credited) / 60, 1) AS block_hours FROM airlines a JOIN crew_members c ON a.airline_id = c.airline_id JOIN crew_assignments ca ON c.crew_member_id = ca.crew_member_id WHERE ca.duty_role = 'captain' AND ca.assignment_status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.name, c.employee_number ORDER BY a.name, c.employee_number ASC
Q40: SELECT a.model, ROUND(SUM(f.fuel_burned_kg) * 1000 / SUM(s.total_weight_kg / 1000 * f.distance_km), 1) AS grams_per_tonne_km FROM aircraft a JOIN aircraft_types at ON a.type_id = at.type_id JOIN flights f ON a.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id JOIN flight_cargo fc ON f.flight_id = fc.flight_id JOIN shipments s ON fc.shipment_id = s.shipment_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' AND s.total_weight_kg > 0 GROUP BY a.model ORDER BY grams_per_tonne_km ASC, a.model ASC
Q41: SELECT s.service_level, COUNT(CASE WHEN te.event_code = 'DLV' THEN 1 END) AS delivered_shipments, COUNT(CASE WHEN te.event_code = 'DLV' AND te.event_time > s.requested_delivery_date THEN 1 END) AS late_shipments, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN te.event_code = 'DLV' AND te.event_time > s.requested_delivery_date THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN te.event_code = 'DLV' THEN 1 END), 1) AS late_pct FROM shipments s JOIN tracking_events te ON s.shipment_id = te.shipment_id GROUP BY s.service_level ORDER BY s.service_level
Q42: SELECT customs_country, COUNT(*) AS cleared_imports, AVG((strftime('%s', cleared_at) - strftime('%s', submitted_at)) / 3600) AS avg_clearance_hours FROM customs_declarations WHERE declaration_type = 'import' AND status = 'cleared' GROUP BY customs_country HAVING cleared_imports >= 50 ORDER BY avg_clearance_hours ASC, customs_country ASC
Q43: SELECT t1.shipment_id, t1.awb_number, SUM(CASE WHEN t2.temperature_c IS NOT NULL AND (t2.temperature_c < t1.min_temperature_c OR t2.temperature_c > t1.max_temperature_c) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_of_range_readings, MAX(CASE WHEN t2.temperature_c IS NOT NULL AND (t2.temperature_c < t1.min_temperature_c OR t2.temperature_c > t1.max_temperature_c) THEN CASE WHEN t2.temperature_c < t1.min_temperature_c THEN t1.min_temperature_c - t2.temperature_c ELSE t2.temperature_c - t1.max_temperature_c END ELSE 0 END) AS max_deviation_c FROM shipments t1 LEFT JOIN tracking_events t2 ON t1.shipment_id = t2.shipment_id GROUP BY t1.shipment_id, t1.awb_number ORDER BY t1.shipment_id
Q44: SELECT i.root_cause, COUNT(*) AS incidents, SUM(CASE WHEN ic.status IN ('approved', 'paid') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS claims, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ic.status IN ('approved', 'paid') THEN ic.approved_amount_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_approved_usd FROM incidents i LEFT JOIN insurance_claims ic ON i.incident_id = ic.incident_id GROUP BY i.root_cause ORDER BY i.root_cause
Q45: SELECT s.awb_number, a.iata_code, cd.status AS import_status FROM shipments s JOIN airports a ON s.destination_airport_id = a.airport_id LEFT JOIN customs_declarations cd ON s.shipment_id = cd.shipment_id AND cd.declaration_type = 'import' WHERE s.status = 'delivered' AND s.awb_number NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT te.shipment_id FROM tracking_events te WHERE te.event_code = 'DLV' ) ORDER BY s.awb_number
